name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A panel sliding in from an edge (start, end, top or bottom), on the same native <dialog> contract as Dialog: showModal() traps focus, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener. Quiet is a hairline panel; warm is a paper panel with a deckled edge over the Carepa surface; playful is the same, brighter, with the slide timed to the Teental cycle's first beat.

budget.reason: 0010: element + core together (5255 bytes today), plus three skins (quiet 0.2 KB, warm 0.7 KB, playful 1.1 KB, which also imports the shared talaDelay from packages/tokens). Carepa and the tokens' Teental export are separate registry items.
